sentences.text: ORAL ORDER (PER : HONOURABLE THE CHIEF JUSTICE MRS. JUSTICE SUNITA AGARWAL)

The petitioner herein is seeking a relief in the nature of mandamus commanding the respondent authorities to make the payment of compensation as per the award passed by respondent no.2.
2.

It is an admitted fact of the matter that for the acquisition proceedings initiated in the year 2011 under the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, the award under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, has been passed on 26.04.2023.

entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
For limited relief prayed herein for disbursement of compensation under the Award dated 26.04.2023, in our NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/12908/2023 ORDER DATED: 07/08/2023 Vadilal Hirabhai Koli Patel vs State Of Gujarat on 7 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/184116788/

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
undefined considered opinion, the petitioner is required to approach the respondent no.2.
3.
It is an admitted fact of the matter that the petitioner instead of approaching respondent no.2, has straightaway filed the instant petition.

4. For the aforesaid, without entering into the claim of the petitioner in the matter of disbursement of compensation, we provide that the petitioner will approach the respondent no.2 by making a proper application giving details of his right, title and interest in the acquired land, so as to establish his claim for disbursement of compensation in the award dated 26.04.2023.

In case such an application is filed within a period of two weeks along with the copy of this order, the respondent no.2 shall be under an obligation to take a decision as expeditiously as possible, preferably within a period of eight weeks from the date of receipt of such application, strictly in accordance with law, by giving due notice and opportunity to all concerned.
5. The petition is disposed of accordingly.
